definitions.gloss: tax return; declaration form; written return
definitions.explanation: A form on which one reports something to an authority, above all income for tax (the {確定申告|かくていしんこく}) or goods at customs. The 〜{書|しょ} marks it as a written document.

examples.japanese: {申告書|しんこくしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I filled out the tax return.

examples.japanese: ⟦{税務署|ぜいむしょ}→税務署：13782_zeimusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{申告書|しんこくしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I submit my tax return to the tax office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{確定申告|かくていしんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{申告書|しんこくしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧⟦{十五日|じゅうごにち}→十五日：27633_juugonichi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: The final income tax return must be submitted by March 15.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入国|にゅうこく}→入国：15859_nyuukoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{機内|きない}→機内：18819_kinai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{税関|ぜいかん}→税関：04380_zeikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{申告書|しんこくしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: When entering the country, it is convenient to fill out the customs declaration form on the plane.

notes:
Made of ⟦{申告|しんこく}→申告：03687_shinkoku⟧ (declaration, filing) + ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (document). In everyday talk it usually means a tax return; the context or a prefix names other kinds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {申告書|しんこくしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to file a return
- {申告書|しんこくしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill in a declaration form
- {確定申告書|かくていしんこくしょ}: final income tax return
- {税関申告書|ぜいかんしんこくしょ}: customs declaration form

USAGE:
In Japan most salaried workers do not file a return, because the employer settles their tax at year end (⟦{年末調整|ねんまつちょうせい}→年末調整：10194_nenmatsuchousei⟧); the self-employed, and people with large medical costs or side income, do.
